completion: 42 new native planning windows from a common physical 2020 seed.

design.hours: Native full-year multisector calendar and original overlapping planning windows.
design.initial_state: Identical complete2020 state including generation, heat, storage, transport, transfer, asset ages and all inherited state files.
design.later_state: Each case passes its own realized native investments, retirements and other state to the next planning step.
design.model: Exact accepted full multisector configuration, not the separate electricity or thermal applications.
design.reference_occurrences: SolarAverage, WindAverage and TemperatureNormal all point to the same Average case; do not solve three duplicate references.
design.spatial_mapping: Use the accepted spatial inputs and transfer matrices; verify the unchanged channels after mapping, not only before mapping.
design.temperature_application: Change only the selected complete temperature chronology; retain the existing heat/cooling/COP adapter and normalization conventions. Export annual demand totals, degree hours and COP so the response is interpreted under the executed conventions.
design.unmodified_inputs: All prices, policies, technology assumptions, other weather/hydro inputs, exchange capacities and solver settings remain those of the accepted multisector model.
design.weather: Same selected 8760-hour synthetic profile at every planning year, without additional climate trends.

interpretation: Compare the total investment-path response under the chosen low/high or cold/hot profiles. Report input ranges alongside effects; judge interesting results by magnitude, technology shifts and consistency, including small or asymmetric responses. Decide the manuscript emphasis after the full comparison is available.
objective: Compare investment and system responses to low/average/high solar, low/average/high wind, and cold/normal/hot temperature in the same full multisector H2RES model.
outputs: scenario_inputs.csv: selected profiles, actual annual/monthly means, yield ranges, heating/cooling degree hours and channel hashes.
investments_by_technology.csv: realized new capacities and retirements per planning year and scenario, in correct physical units.
installed_stock.csv: inherited and resulting stock, distinct from newly built capacity.
investment_costs.csv: source-model investment components and properly reconstructed totals; count each realized investment once and retain model-native monetary conventions.
system_outcomes.csv: electricity and heat mix, imports,exports,CEEP,direct emissions and thermal operating indicators.
objective_comparison.csv: native per-window objective and differences from the shared Average; do not sum overlapping windows as a transition cost.
channel_comparison.csv: low-minus-average,high-minus-average and high-minus-low response with the actual input range for each channel.
Three matched panels for solar,wind,temperature: investment changes by technology against the same Average, plus one concise cross-channel comparison.
Verified manifests, numerical reports, stock-handoff audit and a short factual interpretation of each channel's investment response.

parallel_execution.estimate: Estimate remaining time from measured wall-clock path progress and export duration after first accepted windows; do not infer current server load from old snapshots.
parallel_execution.initial: Two licensed paths, four solver threads each; sequential native years within each path.
parallel_execution.overlap: Export and summarize accepted windows while other paths solve; use a bounded collector and per-worker temporary/cache directories.
parallel_execution.resource_policy: Retain at least128GiB available RAM after predicted worker growth; use measured peaks with safety margin and conservative48GiB per accepted multisector worker,100GiB before measurements; retain100GiB free disk and existing CPU admission policy.
parallel_execution.server: Use the existing computation server and its licensed environment; inspect current CPU,RAM,disk and other work immediately before launch.
parallel_execution.stress: No additional historical stress batch in this first investment comparison. Existing45stress tests retain their own portfolios and scope; optional testing of new portfolios is a separate follow-on decision.
parallel_execution.target: At most two owned active/reserved sessions; shared provider session decisions are honored.
parallel_execution.within_path: Sequential2020->2025->2030->2035->2040->2045->2050; native state handoff must be complete and verified before the next solve.

preflight: Verify frozen ensemble and source manifests; reproduce selection without reading2020-2024 outcomes.
Freeze channel hashes, source-member IDs, groups, annual means, monthly means, annual yields, degree hours and existing trends.
Build isolated model/input/output directories once, with a separate scenario name and full execution manifest for each case.

Compare native numeric inputs for every anchor: solar cases retain identical wind and all thermal inputs; wind cases retain identical solar and all thermal inputs; temperature cases retain identical solar and wind inputs.
Verify hourly calendar, finite values, CF bounds, night zeros, weighted spatial conservation and complete transfer matrices.
Verify exact full2020 initial state and that only the intended climate inputs and their documented downstream thermal transforms vary.
Verify resume/export collector behaviour, unique process identity, atomic checkpoints, objective closure and numerical acceptance before admitting the batch.
recovery: Separate batch root; never modify previous completed results or the GitHub release source tree.
Single controller lease, worker identity uses PID+creation time+script and native child-process checks.
Accepted window marker is written atomically only after solve, numerical checks, objective reconciliation, full state export and hashes.
Resume from the last fully accepted native state; never repeat an accepted window or launch a duplicate orphan solver.
Use bounded retries for transient failures; retain logs and stop a path on a deterministic input or quality failure.
Run a final independent collection even after supervisor interruption, using the accepted original records.

reuse.reason: Weather changes in future slices of the first rolling window too.

source.selection_rule: Retain the previously accepted channel donor IDs; no reselection or retraining.
source.temperature_index: z(cooling degree hours above22C) minus z(heating degree hours below18C), using the frozen ensemble and existing implementation.
